name: Franklin Road at Royalston Street: impassable (waist deep)
quote: Franklin Road at Royalston Street ca stuck in street flooding that was waist deep. Relayed by Amateur Radio.

name: Birch Street: pavement destroyed, asphalt in the road
quote: In Fitchburg there was structural damage to Birch St. Large sections of asphalt were lying on the road with rushing water.

name: John Fitch Highway: flooded
quote: Flooding was also reported around John Fitch Highway and Lunenburg Street.

name: Lunenburg Street: flooded
quote: Flooding was also reported around John Fitch Highway and Lunenburg Street.

name: Pleasantdale Road: impassable
quote: In Rutland, Pleasantdale Road was flooded and impassable.
